text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Fitted to past weather on a screening run. Orange with 80% posterior intervals: the pooled fit P. Blue: Part 2's convex model. The pooled fit's capacity is not identified by the data (a second seed or another start moves it by several points) and is not a measurement.'
text.tspan: Fitted to past weather on a screening run. Orange with 80% posterior intervals: the pooled fit
P. Blue: Part 2's convex model. The pooled fit's capacity is not identified by the data (a
second seed or another start moves it by several points) and is not a measurement.
